description: Parameters of the normalization stage. Applies only to the min_max normalization technique.

lower_bounds.description: Optional. The lower bound of each hybrid query clause, positional against hybrid.queries. When set, must hold 2 to 5 entries — 5 being the maximum hybrid.queries length — and as many entries as any other set weights or bounds. A query may send fewer clauses than there are bounds, in which case only the bounds of the clauses it sends are used; a query that sends more clauses than there are bounds is rejected. If not provided, no lower bound is applied and each clause's actual minimum score is used for normalization.

upper_bounds.description: Optional. The upper bound of each hybrid query clause, positional against hybrid.queries. When set, must hold 2 to 5 entries — 5 being the maximum hybrid.queries length — and as many entries as any other set weights or bounds. A query may send fewer clauses than there are bounds, in which case only the bounds of the clauses it sends are used; a query that sends more clauses than there are bounds is rejected. If not provided, no upper bound is applied and each clause's actual maximum score is used for normalization.
